source_text: Use a fixed `deadline = started_at + 24 hours`; updating `updated_at` must not extend it. Run no earlier than the existing stale-operation boundary. Per cron, admit at most ten recovery operations globally, two per account, and at most thirty Gmail HTTP requests including retries. Do not sleep through backoff inside cron: persist `next_attempt_at`, honoring Retry-After and a maximum 30-minute interval, with at most 288 admitted attempts per operation. A metadata fetch deferred by the request budget resumes on a later run.
